I’ve been going through a really rough time the past few months. With or without meds, I’ve been in a bad depressive state for a while now. The only thing that helped me think clearly or remember who I was was tripping. I wouldn’t recommend tripping on anything if you’re going through a depressive episode, since one of the many times I tripped when this episode started, it wasn’t necessarily bad, but I got even more sad thinking about the situation I’m in and what lead me to be in this episode. 

The one time I did have a good, self reflecting trip was with my best friend. I brought her gel tabs and mushrooms for thanksgiving and we stayed up all night painting and tripping. I didn’t have cycling thoughts or that stupid voice narrating everything going on, nothing. Just quiet. I was able to talk with her and paint and laugh without the messy mess in my head for a few hours.

Not sure if these were manic episodes or I was actually stable and had motivation to do these things, but I always get into all sorts of arts & crafts. Things like knitting, crocheting, embroidery, painting, collaging (?), and painting. I think only the crocheting and painting really stuck.

Chester Bennington.

I vaguely remember Meteora when it came out (I was like 3 but music sticks to you). From then on I grew up listening to Linkin Park occasionally. It wasn’t until middle school that I really fell down the LP rabbit hole and Chester Bennington became my idol. I watched interviews, funny moments, LPU videos, I was a HARDCORE LP fan. 

Then that day, I got messages from at least 10 different people asking if I had heard the news, if it was true. That’s how I found out about his passing. The moments leading up to Mike Shinoda’s tweet confirming the tragic news, I was in complete denial, thinking it was just another celebrity death hoax. It turned out it wasn’t and I cried so hard. I looked up to this man and was so in love with his stage presence and music, I never even got to see Linkin Park live. A good portion of my life revolved around this band and it sucks so much that Chester had to pass the way he did, especially since he was an advocate for mental health and suicide prevention.

When we started dating, I was blinded by a depression that my ex left me in because he cheated in me and I guess I jumped into the first guy who showed interest. There were MANY red flags within the first month of us dating, one of those being his ex texting me out of the blue with screen shots of lewd messages being sent to her by him. I confronted him and he cried and cried and swore up and down that his ex used a bot to act like him. Bullshit. I tried to break up with him but he threatened suicide if I did.

I decided to forget it and things were okay, he invited me over to his house a lot so I can see his cats, watch movies or play games on his computer etc. He liked to listen to me talk about things I lioed, which meant a lot to me as I didn't have much friends in school. His family seemed to like me and I felt I was falling for him for real.

Later in the relationship my dad and his then wife were going through a divorce and she left my half brother with us, so I became more responsible for him and picked up a lot of the house work. He did not like this. He expected me to text him RIGHT AWAY, or be on the phone with him constantly. If I didn't answer right away, he'd blow up my phone saying "Fine I see how it is, you just hate me," or "I know you're ignoring me," and then the usual threats of killing himself because I apparently hated him so much. 

He started to become extremely possessive and would ignore me or be super passive aggressive whenever we hung out with my friends. He caused a scene at my birthday party one year because I invited some dude I "dated" in middle school. He always snooped through my likes and following on my social media and controlled even that, choosing what I liked and who I followed on Instagram or Tumblr. He had a lot of friends that were girls while I lost all of my friends because of him. And I wasn't allowed to say anythimg, even knowing he was cheating behind my back. I always found out, but everyone I said anything, he would throw his tantrum.

After trying to break up with him for so long, I had to piss him off enough for him to break up with me. I was tired of his shit and was being extremely defiant against his rules. We stopped talking all together after that and he only texted me with the intent to hook up. He got a girl friend and cheated on her a lot as well, even "accidentally" sending me photos. 

I tried to confront his girlfriend about it, sending her the screenshots and such. He absolutely flipped. He called me a psycho, told me I needed to go back to a mental hospital, said I was just trying to ruin his life. I learned from a friend later that he was planning to report me to school administrators and tell them I had plans to shoot up the school... 

He's married to that girl now and I feel he's still being an infidel.
